This matrix separates implementation state, the exercise evidence recorded for
that scope, and claims that evidence does not establish. The implemented V1 semantics are **STABILIZED** after reviewed assigned
checks. Release delivery and the exercise evidence below remain separate.

| Backend surface | Implementation | Previously recorded exercise (not rerun here) | Current limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Palace Electrostatic | Stabilized V1 | Route A/B Slurm runs with strict resolution and reports exercised | Exercise scope does not establish all inputs or V1 stability. |
| Palace Eigenmode | Stabilized V1 | Route A/B Slurm runs with strict resolution and reports exercised | This does not validate every Eigenmode EPR output or numerical result. |
| Palace Eigenmode EPR | Accepted surface, bulk, port, reanalysis and report APIs | The guide's paired component examples are static and make no native-solve or numerical-validation claim. | Sidewall energy may remain uncomputed; reported known-loss subtotal is not total device loss. |
| Palace Driven | Not implemented | None | Planned for later. |
| Palace Magnetostatic | Not implemented | None | Planned for later. |
| HFSS Eigenmode | Stabilized V1 | AEDT 2024.2 run and strict resolution exercised | Run/resolve exercise does not establish every saved-field EPR branch. |
| HFSS Driven Modal | Stabilized V1 | AEDT 2024.2 run and strict resolution exercised | Evidence is limited to the named run/resolve scope. |
| HFSS Driven Terminal | Stabilized V1 | AEDT 2024.2 run and strict resolution exercised | Evidence is limited to the named run/resolve scope. |
| Q3D | Stabilized V1 | AEDT 2024.2 run and strict resolution exercised | Evidence is limited to the named run/resolve scope. |
| Q2D | Stabilized V1 | AEDT 2024.2 run and strict resolution exercised | Evidence is limited to the named run/resolve scope. |
| AEDT Eigenmode EPR | Accepted saved-field and history paths | A bounded unsolved probe loaded four dependent expression definitions; the full inset-sheet library is not verified. | The probe does not establish field-side selection or numerical EPR accuracy. |
| Meep | Excluded | None | Not planned. |

An exercised run is evidence only for its named scope. It does not establish
universal solver correctness, numerical convergence, cross-backend agreement,
or independently grant V1 acceptance. A namespace name or source-lane identity is not support.

Use the [Eigenmode and Offline EPR guide](eigenmode-epr.qmd) for the method and
static workflow. The backend specifications own exact behavior:
[AEDT Runtime Families](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd) and
[Palace Electrostatic + SGB](specs/palace-electrostatic-sgb.qmd). The
[Unified Report Model](report-model.qmd) describes result presentation and
availability.

## Learn an implemented workflow

Use the [course map](examples.qmd#choose-the-physical-question) for the
Electrostatic, ordinary Eigenmode, Eigenmode/EPR, Driven Modal/Terminal, Q3D
and Q2D lessons. The common course distinguishes source preparation, native
geometry observation, explicit solve and verified return. A new documentation
render is evidence of the readable site, not another solver exercise.
